dimensions.assessment: Affects hospitals serving as GNE hubs, nursing schools, community-based care settings, and advanced practice registered nurse students nationwide.
dimensions.evidence: an eligible hospital may receive payment for the hospital's reasonable costs... for the provision of qualified clinical education to advanced practice registered nurses.

dimensions.assessment: Provides funding and structured clinical training programs for advanced practice registered nurses, potentially altering educational and workforce pipelines.
dimensions.evidence: establish a national graduate nurse education program to provide clinical training to advanced practice registered nurses

dimensions.assessment: Requires transfers of sums as necessary from the Medicare trust funds to the CMS Program Management Account.
dimensions.evidence: the Secretary shall provide for the transfer, from the Federal Hospital Insurance Trust Fund... and the Federal Supplementary Medical Insurance Trust Fund... of such sums as the Secretary determines necessary

dimensions.assessment: Amends Title XVIII of the Social Security Act to create a new permanent federal program with specific reporting, partnership, and reimbursement mandates.
dimensions.evidence: Title XVIII of the Social Security Act (42 U.S.C. 1395 et seq.) is amended by inserting after section 1866G the following new section

dimensions.assessment: Establishes a permanent ongoing program with recurring annual reporting and funding mechanisms.
dimensions.evidence: This bill establishes a permanent National Graduate Nurse Education Program

missing_information: Exact total dollar amounts or caps for the fund transfers from the Medicare trust funds are not specified in the text.
importance_detail.rationale: Establishes a permanent National Graduate Nurse Education Program under Medicare to reimburse eligible hospitals for reasonable clinical education costs for advanced practice registered nurses, directly affecting participating hospitals, nursing schools, and nursing students across the country.
